title: Rickover tells Townsend Brown the Navy already figured it out

tellings.quote: Tonsen Brown goes to Hyman Rick Rickover who is the head of the nuclear navy basically started the American nuclear navy and himman And Rick over says, "Uh, towns and you know, stop wasting your time. Like we've already figured this stuff out back then."

plain: A researcher named Thomas Townsend Brown once went to Hyman Rickover, the admiral who basically started America's nuclear navy, and Rickover told him to stop wasting his time because "we've already figured this stuff out back then." Michels tells it himself, naming a writer called Paul LaViolette among his sources, in a conversation with a former Navy fighter pilot named Ryan Graves. If true, it would mean the Navy had quietly solved the exotic technology Brown was chasing.
